تعتصرن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِرْنَ (taʕtaṣirna) /taʕ.ta.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# تُعْتَصَرْنَ (tuʕtaṣarna) /tuʕ.ta.sˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
